resolvedFindings.issue: An interrupted matcher left a permanent exclusive file lock.

resolvedFindings.issue: Removing the web input outline removed the visible focus treatment on fields with errors.
resolvedFindings.resolution: The rounded outer Card receives an accent focus outline independently of the error border; the inner default outline remains removed only on web.

resolvedFindings.issue: Missing inventory collectedAt could produce invalid coverage JSON.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Coverage validates inventory version, country and collectedAt before any writes.
